capacity_metric_note: Q_sim integrates the experimentally measured current over the experimental time window, so Q_sim ~= Q_exp by construction.  Do NOT read baseline Q_sim-Q_exp as a capacity prediction; predictive capacity requires a constant-current run where the model itself reaches the cutoff.

parameter_match.notes: Unfitted surrogate baseline - NOT physics-model validation. Chen2020 matches the 20R chemistry family (NMC/graphite) and its exact voltage window (2.5-4.2 V), but was fitted to the LG M50 5.0 Ah pouch cell, so the 2.0 Ah 20R cell sees structurally lower model C-rates.  Initial SOC per window comes from the CALCE filename SOC label (low confidence).
